problem: ns-gm currently has a fire-and-forget execution model: user code is sent to a NetSuite RESTlet and executed immediately with no approval gate, dry-run, or change preview. The ticket requires adding a two-phase RESTlet approach (Approach B from prior research) with dry-run and execute-approved actions, where N/record write methods are intercepted by proxy wrappers during dry-run to capture before/after state without committing. ns-gm must remain fully functional for standalone (non-Helix) users.

The proxy module pattern will be implemented here—wrapping N/record to intercept save/submitFields/delete during dry-run. Lines 23-37 define the action dispatcher; lines 63-96 define the module map; lines 163-188 define safeExecute.
Express proxy server with /run and /logs endpoints. Must be extended with /dry-run and /execute endpoints for the two-phase flow. Lines 35-86 define the /run endpoint pattern to replicate.

facts: RESTlet currently supports 2 actions: 'run' (line 26) and 'getscriptexecutionlogs' (line 29). Unknown actions return error (line 33).
Code execution uses new Function(...moduleNames, userCode) with 24 pre-loaded N/* modules injected as arguments (line 166).
Module map at lines 71-96 defines all available modules including record, search, query, log, etc.
The proxy server at server/app.js reads code and optional modules from req.body (line 37) and forwards to RESTlet via nsapi.REST.post().
Prior research (ticket cmnqr8lkk000hiq0usgmitppy) recommends Approach B: Two-Phase RESTlet with module proxy for dry-run.

Proxy modules in this context means: wrapping N/record within the RESTlet to intercept write operations (save, submitFields, delete) during dry-run, while passing through read operations and all other N/* modules.
Prior tech-research specifies: body field discovery via getFields(), common sublist iteration (item, expense, line, partner, salesteam), and agent-provided targetSublistIds hints.
Prior tech-research specifies: HMAC approval token generated server-side, included in execute-approved requests, validated by the Helix server (not the RESTlet).
Governance budget is 5000 units per RESTlet invocation. Safety threshold: abort if remaining < 200 units.
RESTlet is deployed both as ns_gm_restlet.js in ns-gm repo root and as netsuite-setup/FileCabinet/SuiteScripts/ns_gm_restlet.js in helix-global-server. The server copy is deployed via SDF.
ns-gm has no test framework, no lint scripts, no typecheck scripts in package.json. Quality gates are limited to manual testing.
No EXECUTE tickets exist in production (0 out of 214 total tickets). TicketMode.EXECUTE is defined but unused.
helix-global-server build script includes 'prisma migrate deploy', confirming file-based-migrations strategy.
Backward compatibility: new actions are additive. Existing 'run' and 'getscriptexecutionlogs' remain unchanged. Non-Helix users using only ns-gm CLI will not be affected.
